subject: Technical deep-dive: join options and room/AV contingency
messages:
From: Sam Clark <sam.clark@nebulaapps.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria@nebulaapps.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: 60–90m technical deep-dive (model infra + routing)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick intro call. Nebula's infra and platform teams would like a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive to walk through routing, fallbacks, and the batching/quantization trade-offs you discussed. Ideally we'd do this in-person at your SF office so both teams can whiteboard, but we're flexible to join remotely.

Our preferred dates are Feb 16–18 in the mornings (PST). Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood can host in Room 2B or similar? If an on-site room isn't possible, a Google Meet or Zoom with a dedicated room system will work.

Also: we'll want to share an architecture deck (we have a short PDF) and do a quick AV check before the session.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Clark
Engineering Manager, Nebula Apps
sam.clark@nebulaapps.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Clark <sam.clark@nebulaapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 60–90m technical deep-dive (model infra + routing)

Hi Sam — great to hear. Feb 16 or 17 both look promising for us. I can do:
 - Tue Feb 16: 10:00–12:00 PST
 - Wed Feb 17: 14:00–17:00 PST (we can do a 90-min block at 14:00)

If Nebula prefers in-person, I'll ask ops to reserve a room and test AV in advance. Otherwise we'd do a dual-join: Google Meet + a Zoom room system fallback.

Looping in Marissa (Ops) to confirm room availability and Laura to send the calendar invite once we lock the time.

Can you confirm which of the two windows you prefer and whether you plan to bring any devices (Mac/PC) that need HDMI or USB-C passthrough? Also please attach the deck you mentioned so ops can size the display needs.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-11T08:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 60–90m technical deep-dive (model infra + routing)

Karthik — quick ops update.

Heads up: Room 2B is out on Feb 16 between 08:00–18:00 for a firmware/video-codec upgrade we scheduled last month; the upgrade was pushed earlier, so we can't guarantee availability that day.

Backup options:
 - Room 4A (2x 4k displays, Poly Studio USB conference bar) — HDMI passthrough works but we need a dongle for Mac USB-C. No native Zoom appliance; we'll use a laptop as the room system.
 - Conference Suite (1st floor) — has a dedicated Zoom appliance but only a single HDMI input and older display (1080p).

Recommendation: book Room 4A and also create a Zoom meeting link as the room/system fallback. If Nebula wants to whiteboard, we can reserve a small whiteboard cart.

I've attached two photos of Room 4A and a short ops checklist. Ops contact for day-of: Connor O'Brien (ext 312).

Attachments: room-photos-ops.jpg

Marissa Cole
Head of Office Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-11T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 60–90m technical deep-dive (model infra + routing)

On Thu, Feb 11, 2027 at 08:25 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Heads up: Room 2B is out on Feb 16 between 08:00–18:00 for a firmware/video-codec upgrade...

Thanks — I'll take point on the room setup. Proposed playbook:
1) Reserve Room 4A for Wed Feb 17, 14:00–15:30 PST (90 min).
2) Create a Zoom meeting (cloud recording off) and a Google Calendar invite with a Meet link — include both links in the invite so attendees can use whichever works.
3) Bring the HDMI rolling cart + USB-C (Thunderbolt 3) adapter and a spare MacBook for display handoff.
4) Schedule a 15-min AV test at 13:15 on the same day for Nebula + our techs.
5) Day-of checklist: HDMI confirmed, mic level check, camera framing, screen-share test.

I'll reserve the cart and confirm the AV test with Sam.

—Connor
Senior IT Engineer, Redwood Inference
